title: KNBS county crop production (Area + Production), Kenya
source: KNBS National Agriculture Production Report — 2023-24 edition (2019-2023) + 2024-25 edition (2024, provisional)
citation: KNBS. National Agriculture Production Report. Nairobi, Kenya.
license: KNBS official statistics — public; cite KNBS.
method: Deterministic dual-engine extraction (_sources/napr_extract.py + napr_build.py): pymupdf-authoritative + pdfplumber cross-check, coordinate column-binning, orientation auto-detect, wrapped-name merge. A crop-county-year is served only if the county sum reconciles to the annex's printed national Total (additivity) and, where the 2nd engine reads the page, the two agree cell-by-cell. Cross-edition rebase to the latest edition. No number read/typed by a model. 2026-10-15 (U1, _sources/napr_fix_2026-10-15.md): the former 'Sugarcane' rows (NAPR 2024 T4.3 'Sugar Made by County' p47, NAPR 2025 T5.3.3 'Sugar Production by County' p99) are SUGAR output and are now crop 'Sugar (made)'; crop 'Sugarcane' is now county CANE from NAPR 2024 Annex 12 p126 (area_ha = area under cane, production_t = cane deliveries, 2019-2023, value_ksh null), gated by dual-engine 1.0, 100% additivity on all 20 columns, sugar columns == T4.3 and cane totals == national T4.2. 2026-10-16 (_sources/napr_fix_2026-10-15.md, section 2026-10-16): the parquet is now produced by a full napr_build.py rebuild, which reproduces every previous row exactly (the 2026-10-15 sugar and Tharaka-Nithi tea patches are superseded). The rebuild restores Kilifi (broken-font label '.iliʢ', NAPR 2024) via an exact glyph map in napr_extract.py, and converts Pyrethrum area from acres (as printed in NAPR 2024 T4.21 and NAPR 2025 T5.6.1) to hectares (x 0.404686); before, it was served in acres under area_ha.
coverage: 32 crops (incl. 'Sugar (made)' 2019-2024 and 'Sugarcane' = cane 2019-2023; no 2024 county cane is published), 2019-2024 (2024 provisional from the 2025 edition). Cross-edition overlap rebased to the 2025 edition; edition diffs in _sources/edition_diffs_2024ed_vs_2025ed.csv.
used_by: notebook §1.1 'What does my county produce?' (Crops view)
